desc: The TRUGLO TruBrite Red/Green Dot Sight includes a wide 24 x 34mm window with unlimited eye relief to allow instant sight acquisition and accurate shooting. The TruBright reflex sight's dual color options and 4 reticle styles can be switched on the fly to provide the best contrast and clearest dot sight for the situation. The Weaver mounted tactical sight is a great choice for AR-15 and other modern sporting rifles.
